provenance.source_integrity: Run operator verified git diff --exit-code and unchanged git write-tree before and after all probes. Temporary startup/paging/no-history and table-wheel/paging/selection cross-tests passed and were moved out before measurement.
provenance.scheduling_scope: Serial measurements; no other build/test/measurement command from the measurement session overlapped. No claim that the global host was idle.
provenance.attribution: Host, command environment, preflight test success, and before/after source checks are run-operator provenance; timestamps, benchmark statistics, sample counts, probe rows, test summaries, and hashes are extracted from artifacts.
provenance.criterion_digest_algorithm: Sort relative combined-22-26/benchmark.json paths lexicographically. For each directory, hash benchmark.json, estimates.json, sample.json in that order: UTF-8 source-relative path, NUL, exact file bytes, NUL; one aggregate SHA-256.

criterion.statistic: MEAN, not the console slope estimate
criterion.sample_count_evidence: Both sample.json iters and times lengths checked for every case; 108 Collecting 100 samples and Analyzing log entries match all benchmark full_id values.

methodology.timing_boundary: Complete logical application turn through each test backend. Persistent fixtures have prebuilt models and initial settlement outside timing; explicit action resets are untimed. Cold iter includes model/harness construction, first draw, and scope destruction. No production ANSI serialization, terminal lifecycle, producer scheduling, or PTY latency.
methodology.timing_details: Collection line navigation uses one clock around the ArborUI loop, but accumulates per-turn intervals on Ratatui; other groups use the iter/iter_custom paths in application_turns.rs. Append actions do not reset their growing bounded model; initial history is 100000, configured limit 1100000. Table updates advance revision. These are not isolated renderer benchmarks.
methodology.patch_recording: Disabled before initial settlement in all ArborUI timing and TestApp memory fixtures. Validation, committed frames, recovery, and settle counters remain enabled. Ordinary tests/output probes keep default recording. Phase probes use AppRunner, not TestApp.
methodology.storm: One iteration/row is the aggregate of eight complete resize turns, not one turn. Criterion throughput Elements is 8 for storms and 1 otherwise.
methodology.output: Debug-profile test runner, real production Crossterm serializers with ANSI16 capabilities; bytes presented to writer, writer callbacks (not syscalls), flushes. Ratatui resize includes production clear and draw. Integer counts, not timing estimates.
methodology.memory: 142 separate release-mode DHAT processes. model includes application data/providers; initial-render prebuilds model outside profiling; cold includes model; actions prebuild settled fixtures. Retained bytes/blocks are allocations made during profiling still live before result drop, not total RSS, net size change, or evidence of a leak. All byte columns are bytes; allocations/blocks/items are counts.

memory_after_drop.assertion: tests/memory_metrics.rs assert_released checks end_blocks == 0 and end_bytes == 0 before printing every row

phase.harness: AppRunner headless, not TestApp or Criterion
phase.boundary: Initial render excludes prebuilt model and runner construction. Render total is separately timed, not a sum of displayed phase columns; no production terminal output.

methodology.parity_scope: Semantic/character assertions across matched traces; full styled-cell equivalence for overlay and specific table ID-cell style assertions only. Table gaps/focus styles intentionally differ. New table wheel parity is functional coverage, not a Criterion timing-matrix case.
methodology.interpretation: Only this host/run and combined tree. No historical WSL speedup or isolated patch-recording-policy effect; no global framework winner. Repeated history regression tests, not single-operation DHAT retention, establish removal of unbounded test patch history. O(n) application model remains.
methodology.extraction: Node 24 deterministic artifact parsing only; mean numeric lexemes preserved with JSON.parse reviver context.source and JSON.rawJSON, without rounding. Probe tables retain original headers, row labels, integer values, and test order. Rows are compact arrays indexed by their enclosing columns.
